subject: lk-imp
title: LK.IMP.------BIA.
description: Chart on book p. 277 (CMBA-33). LK-IMP (linkage implications) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; BIA (bi-aitional) is the partner. From the subject: T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) and EXT-CONT. From T-C-IMP: ALT-F (alternative functionalism). From EXT-CONT: EXT-DY (extended dynamics). From ALT-F: AF-COMP (affinity compression). From EXT-DY: IF-ST-DY (infra-structure dynamics). From AF-COMP: DYM-SEP (dynamic separation). From IF-ST-DY: IST-P. From DYM-SEP: INTL (intellectualism). From INTL: MT-DEVF (multiple diversification). INTL has the (P) prefix, "point of idea completion".
